title: Parts Velocity report still lists an inactive part's sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part sold 2 times on an invoiced part sale [PS-1] today, then set inactive.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PVKEEP PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PVKEEP-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PVKEEP-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PVKEEP PART).
  3. Go to Customers, create a customer named (e.g.) "ZZAUTOTEST PL PVKEEP Customer" and save it. [Cust-1] = that customer.
  4. Go to Parts → Part Sales, start a new part sale for [Cust-1]. [PS-1] = the part sale number shown (e.g. P2-89).
  5. On [PS-1] open the Parts tab, click "Add Part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the inventory row, set Quantity to 2 and click "Save & Close".
  6. Pick [Part-A] on [PS-1] and click "Create Invoice" on its Finance tab.
  7. Go to Reports → Parts Velocity for a range that includes today, search [Part-A]. [PV-1] = the figures on its row (e.g. quantity 2).
  8. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  9. Check the setup worked: [PV-1] is written down and [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Reports → Parts Velocity with the same range.
  2. Search [Part-A].
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: [Part-A] is listed and its figures equal [PV-1] (quantity 2).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-E11, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E11: “Reports keep inactive parts. Inventory Value, Parts Velocity and the dashboard include them, because their stock still has value and their history still happened.”
